capital.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
capital.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent

execution.at_open: Execute the single earliest-due pending intent when due_index<=current_index and actual position permits; stale intent is logged and discarded, no same-open exit then reentry. Actual timestamp override only as declared for M1180.
at_close_sequence: Update completed-bar indicators and holding counter, compute raw entry/raw exit independent of current position
If M1180 long and completed_count>=20, latch time_exit until the position is closed; it cannot be cancelled by entry filters
A raw opposite signal cancels a pending opposite intent before considering a new one, irrespective of current holdings; for M1180 a latched timeexit is exempt
Schedule new buy only when flat and raw_entry; schedule new sell only when long and raw_exit or time_exit. If both raw directions occur, sell/cancel-buy priority; do not buy
Same-side repeated intent retains its original earliest due index, never postpone due to repeated signals
No signal at equality unless explicitly inclusive; no warmup-generated intent; no fill at or beyond evaluation end
execution.raw_M1258: entry=previous-ready RSI<=50 and current>50; exit=previous-ready RSI>=50 and current<50; computed independently of holdings so a raw opposite cross cancels a pending order even when no new order is eligible
execution.lag2_example: A pending buy at t+2 is cancelled by opposite raw signal at close t+1. An uncancelled same-side signal does not move due from t+2. A 20-bar exit scheduled at e+19 closes at e+21 for lag2; no perpetual defer.

valuation: Endbar equity=cash+quantity*rawclose. No funding/interest, no dividend assumptions needed for spot BTC. No terminal liquidation or hypothetical exit fee; report residual inventory and pending action separately. No fill outside evaluation.

allocation.rounding_disclosure: fee=budget-notional closes the Decimal allocation exactly. Product quantity*fill may differ by final Decimal rounding; freeze this arithmetic order, no negative-cash tolerance/clipping, no implicit reserve, no price/tick rounding.
allocation.terminal: mark raw last close without forced sale or unincurred exit fees; report holdings and unexecuted intent

indicators.EMA200: First seed arithmetic average closes indices0..199 at index199; earlier NaN. Thereafter alpha2/201, recursive prev+alpha*(C-prev).
indicators.ATR14: TR0=H0-L0; TRt=max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)). Seed averageTR0..13 at13; thereafter Wilder alpha1/14.
indicators.ADX14: Directional moves only t>=1: up=H[t]-H[t-1],down=L[t-1]-L[t]; +DM=up iff up>down and up>0 else0; -DM=down iff down>up and down>0 else0. Ties both0. Seed smoothedTR/+DM/-DM as averages t1..14 at14. Wilder update1/14; DI=100*DM/TR, both0 whenTR=0. DX=100*abs(+DI--DI)/(+DI+-DI),0 if denominator0. ADX first meanDX14..27 at27 then Wilder1/14. Deliberately separate ATR seed above; exact research convention, not claimed Pine default.
indicators.Donchian30: At decisionclose t upper=max(H[t-30:t]),lower=min(L[t-30:t]); exactly30 completed priorbars, excludes current for BOTH entry and exit.

entry: Flat, all ready, C>upper AND ADX>=22 AND C>EMA200 AND ATR>0 AND (C-upper)/ATR>=0.5; strict close inequalities, inclusive22/.5. ATR0 blocks entry.
exit: Long at decisionclose: C<priorlower OR held_completed_bars>=20. Both -> one exit reason time_and_channel. No close==lower exit.
holding_counter: Fill at open e resets completed_count0; close e increments1, close e+19 increments20 and triggers timeexit; normal nextopen e+20 yields20heldbars. delay2 intentionally yields21heldbars. Exit is close-triggered schedule, not intrabar hard expiry.
cold_start: Keep eval2023-01-01 unchanged:186pre-evalbars. EMA ready only close globalindex199 (14th evalbar), first possible nextopen index200. Cash before readiness is a result, not missing data or shortened evaluation. All features ready does not imply convergence.
